players.product: Apple Silicon (A19 / A19 Pro, M5) — leading-edge logic on TSMC N2/N3

quarterly_data.signal: Apple introduced Apple HomeView on October 13, 2026: a home device with a 7-inch Liquid Retina display (a tabletop model on a domed speaker base and a separate wall-mounted model) featuring Siri AI, recognition of up to six users by face, music, FaceTime and smart home control; HomeView and its A18 chip include Secure Exclaves, and Siri requests can use on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute. Pre-orders started October 13 in Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, the UK and the U.S. at $299 (U.S.) for both models (Singapore from October 15), with availability beginning November 13. 'Apple HomeView is not available for sale in the European Union, as Siri AI is currently unavailable in iOS in the EU. Apple is working constructively with the EU in an attempt to find a path forward.' The wall-mounted model uses three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home (Power Mount PoE Wired available starting in early 2027 for $129.95). Greg Joswiak, Apple's senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing: 'it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core'.
quarterly_data.figure: 7-inch display; A18 chip; $299; available November 13; not sold in the EU
